title: WA Recovery Pro v1.9.9 — Native Voice Note Sync & Dual Screenshot Fallback
changelog: 🔄 Native Voice Sync: getVoiceNotes bridge syncs SQLite voice recordings with complete audio paths to Web UI
🔊 Full Playback & Sharing: Voice notes now properly load on-device paths for instant speaker playback and direct WhatsApp sharing
📸 Dual Screenshot Fallback: Automatically falls back to MediaProjection if Accessibility is unavailable on OEM
🎥 16-Pixel Aligned Video Recording: High compatibility across all Android devices
